note: Candidate non-earthquake ground events, 17 Jun - 31 Oct 2026, found by web search of public pages (no catalogue download). Sources are search-result pages read on 14 Nov 2026; figures are quoted as the source gives them. 'nisar' = GUNW pairs found with the ASF search API (track/frame, 12-day pairs).

events.where: Langtang Lirung, Nepal-China border (28.3 N 85.5 E)
facts: Seismic signal 02:52 UTC on 26 Aug 2026 (Ms 5.2 USGS, Mw 5.7 GFZ), generated by the collapse itself (Wikipedia, citing USGS and GFZ)
estimated 132 million m3 of rock and glacier ice (ICIMOD preliminary synthesis, via search summary)
source zone about 2,000 m long with about 1,150 m drop (PreventionWeb)
Sentinel-1 showed up to 40 cm LOS deformation 7 Jul - 24 Aug (press coverage of a Virginia Tech analysis); a NISAR paper reports motion 20 Jun - 19 Aug 2026 (Remote Sensing 18(21):3727)
events.nisar: asc track 98 frame 16: 19-31 Aug (event), 14-26 Jul (control); desc track 48 frame 74: 16-28 Aug (event), 11-23 Jul (control)
events.verdict_reason: 8.5 km2 patch at 28.32 N 85.48 E, 4.7x the next largest, both look directions
